environment.GITLAB_POST_RECONFIGURE_SCRIPT:
gitlab-rails runner /opt/vulhub/initialize-gitlab.rb
sed -i 's/listen 127\.0\.0\.1:80/listen *:80/' /var/opt/gitlab/nginx/conf/service_conf/gitlab-rails.conf
grep -Fq 'listen *:80' /var/opt/gitlab/nginx/conf/service_conf/gitlab-rails.conf
/opt/gitlab/embedded/sbin/nginx -t -p /var/opt/gitlab/nginx
gitlab-ctl restart nginx
environment.GITLAB_OMNIBUS_CONFIG:
external_url 'http://gitlab.example.com'
gitlab_rails['gitlab_shell_ssh_port'] = 10022
gitlab_rails['initial_root_password'] = 'vulhub123456'
letsencrypt['enable'] = false
gitlab_rails['nginx']['listen_addresses'] = ['127.0.0.1']
